root_cause: Chat was explicitly limited to signed-in viewers even though the fingerprint guest start path was repaired. Persisted account chat choices could also remain visible or be reused across an identity change.
repair: Expose Chat to guests and default the sidepanel to it.
Route every guest Chat start to the server-resolved extend.browser_chat Mandate, ignoring saved account Agent ids and avoiding signed-in execution reads.
Wait for both auth resolution and chat storage hydration, then clear account conversation, messages, draft, variables, attachments, compute binding and agent choice when the chat actor changes.
Fence a cancelled stream synchronously before its asynchronous service-worker cancel so late events cannot restore cleared content.
server_contract_observed_in_source: The current aidream /v2/ai/mandates/{key} path resolves a fingerprint guest using the system Mandate rung. agent_run installs the server-resolved guest organization before the conversation write. The extension stream transport sends X-Fingerprint-ID and strips organization_id for guests.
